reason: Fifteen hundred a month is less than one night's till, and the free month means I risk nothing, so I will put it in one venue and watch. The part I actually want is the screen settling a disputed frame, because right now that argument lands in my WhatsApp group at eleven at night and I am the referee.
objection: My staff will not learn new software. I have three managers who still send me the fixtures as a photo of a piece of paper, and if the boy on the counter cannot set the bracket up in a minute on a busy Tuesday he will just go back to the group and the thing dies quietly while I keep paying.
would_change_my_mind: Someone comes to the venue and trains my counter staff on a real competition night, and it works without me standing there.
